public abstract class Map<A, B>
  extends Aggregate<A>
{
    public abstract boolean defines(A elem);
    public boolean defines(Aggregate<A> other);
    public Map<A, B> define(A elem,
                            B value);
    public abstract Map<A, B> define(Aggregate<A> other);
    public Map<A, B> define(Aggregate<A> elems,
                            Aggregate<A> values)
      throws NoSuchElementException;
    public Pair<Map<A, B>, B> replace(A elem,
                                      B value)
      throws NoSuchElementException;
    public Map<A, B> undefine(A elem);
    public abstract Map<A, B> undefine(Aggregate<A> other);
    public abstract B get(A elem)
      throws NoSuchElementException;
    public Seq<B> get(Aggregate<A> elems)
      throws NoSuchElementException;
    public Set<A> domain();
    public Seq<B> range();
    public abstract <C> Map<A, C> map((B) -> C f);
    public Map<A, B> filter((A, B) -> boolean p);
    public <C> Map<A, C> compose(Map<A, B> other)
      throws NoSuchElementException;
    public <C, D> Map<A, D> merge(Map<A, B> other,
                                  (A, Option<A>, Option<A>) -> Option<A> mf);
    public Map();
}
